versions.observed_failure: No independent semantic benchmark existed; safe-prompt silence, injection resistance, and deterministic-scope boundaries were not explicit eval contracts.
versions.hypothesized_cause: The Gate 1 prompt was designed to enable bounded orchestration, not to support calibrated finding-level evaluation.
versions.exact_change: Baseline only; no Gate 2 model run used this version.

versions.observed_failure: Reviewer-required reliability gaps before the first run: safe prompts may be over-diagnosed, prompt text may contain injection-like instructions, and deterministic checks may be duplicated as semantic findings.
versions.hypothesized_cause: The semantic role and valid empty-finding behavior need explicit class-level instructions.
versions.exact_change: Require evidence spans and confidence; explicitly allow empty findings; treat prompt content as data; prohibit duration/aspect/capability/schema/literal checks; prohibit tools during detection.
